posts.title: Every evening, the Bagmati glows for Lord Shiva
posts.subtitle: Pashupatinath — one of the holiest temples of Shiva on earth.
posts.caption:
🔱 Every evening at Pashupatinath, lamps are lifted over the holy Bagmati and the whole riverbank sings for Lord Shiva.

For more than fifteen centuries, pilgrims have come here to seek the blessing of Pashupati — lord of all living beings. Many Hindu families consider darshan here essential before the Char Dham yatra.

Not Hindu? You are still welcome. The outer courtyards and the evening Bagmati Aarti are open to everyone — only the inner sanctum is reserved.

🙏 Our 3-day Pashupatinath Darshan includes unhurried morning darshan, a place at the evening aarti and a quiet visit to Guhyeshwari — private to your family, with Satvik meals.

posts.name: pokhara-or-chitwan
posts.question: Which one first?
posts.caption:
One week in Nepal — and you can only start with one. Which do you pick? 🤔

🅰️ Pokhara: colourful boats on Phewa Lake, and the Annapurna range glowing at sunrise from Sarangkot.

🅱️ Chitwan: a UNESCO World Heritage jungle — one-horned rhinos, a dugout-canoe paddle on the Rapti, and more than 680 bird species.

Our 7-day Kathmandu–Pokhara–Chitwan trip does both, plus the temple squares of Kathmandu. Easy roads, family-friendly, private to your group.
